newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia pension fund assets up 6.8 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: Colombia pension fund assets up 6.8 pct in June.

text.p: Colombia's private pension fund assets rose 6.8 percent in June to a total of 1.2 trillion pesos, the Banking Superintendency said.

It said the monthly increase stemmed, at least in part, from a 1.9 percent rise in the number of affiliates across the country. That number stood at 2.26 million as of June 30, the latest date for which official figures are available.
Colombia established its private pension fund system in 1994 and a total of nine funds now operate in the country.
The largest of the funds is Porvenir of the Luis Carlos Sarmiento industrial group followed by Proteccion of the powerful Sindicato Antioqueno conglomerate.
